description_expanded: Escape to SeaView, a stunning gulf-front house in Santa Rosa Beach with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico. This beautifully renovated home offers luxurious finishes, steps from the Watercolor Beach Club. Enjoy access to pools, Camp Watercolor, and the beach club for an unforgettable vacation. Indulge in breathtaking Gulf views from the second-floor balcony of this stunning house. The open-plan living area and kitchen, also on the second floor, offer the best views. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and generous counter space. This house comfortably accommodates your family with three bedrooms and three bathrooms, perfect for a beach vacation. A guest bedroom on the second floor features a stylish king-sized bed and has access to a hall bathroom with a single vanity and shower. Additional seating on the second-floor landing creates a cozy spot for puzzles or snacks. The first floor is meticulously designed. A welcoming, bright hallway leads to two bedrooms. The first guest bedroom has a king-sized bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, with access to the back porch for relaxation. The second guest bedroom offers a king bed with two lofted twin beds and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, also with access to the back porch. A convenient laundry room is located on the first floor. Highlights include: Sleeps 8 3 Bedrooms 3 Bathrooms Private Gulf Front Private Beach Professionally Decorated Parking for 2 Vehicles Full Access to WaterColor Community Pools First Floor: Guest bedroom with a king bed and two twin beds, private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and porch access Guest bedroom with a king-sized bed, private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and porch access Laundry room Second Floor: Main living space with Gulf views Kitchen with stainless steel appliances Dining table with Gulf views Guest bedroom with a king bed and shared hall bathroom Hall bathroom with a shower Balcony with high-top table and lounge seating Outdoor Space: Porch and balcony with chaise lounges and tables Outdoor shower Parking for 2 vehicles Additional: High-speed WiFi; No events allowed; No pets. Enjoy full access to this stunning beachfront house and its incredible amenities. You'll have private access to all three bedrooms, three bathrooms, the open-plan living area, fully equipped kitchen, and the second-floor balcony with breathtaking Gulf views. Guests also have full access to the WaterColor community pools, the Watercolor Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, and the Lazy River. Located steps from the Watercolor Beach Club. You'll enjoy access to 9 Watercolor pools, Camp Watercolor, Lazy River, as well as the Beach Club with private beach access. We are available to assist you throughout your stay! You can reach us via your chosen platform with any questions or concerns. We typically respond within a few hours, but rest assured—we’ll do our best to get back to you as quickly as possible. For urgent matters, please note it in your message. We’re committed to ensuring you have a fantastic vacation experience! Please note: This property comes with 4 beach chairs and two umbrellas, which can be set up daily behind the home. There is also a beach wagon for transporting items to the beach, and 8 towels are provided for your comfort. After booking, you will be provided with a digital guidebook that lists any other complimentary amenities available in the home. LUXE 30A does not guarantee the inclusion or perfect working order of these items. They are not part of the rental agreement. The primary renter must be 25 years of age or older, with at least one guest aged 25+ for every three guests in the group. Getting around SeaView is easy. Parking is available on-site for two vehicles. While public transportation options are limited in this area, the home's prime location makes it convenient to access local attractions and the beautiful beaches. The closest airport is Destin-Fort Walton Beach Airport (VPS), approximately a 40-minute drive away. You can easily arrange for a rideshare service or taxi to reach the property.
